_comment: Agent Access Audit policy (P6). Copy to agent-access-policy.json to activate. OPTIONAL: with no policy file the audit runs on the learned baseline alone. A policy turns 'new vs. baseline' into approved / denied. Names, hosts and scopes only — a credential value is never read. 'default' applies to every agent; an 'agents' entry (keyed by the agent's program name, e.g. 'claude') extends the default for that one agent.
